must.item: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
must.why: No image was produced because the edit was refused for insufficient credits.

must.item: His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
must.why: No output image exists; the navy suit was only planned.

must.item: The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
must.why: No image was generated, so the backdrop was not changed.

must.item: Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
must.why: Nothing was rendered, so no lighting change occurred.

must.item: The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.
must.why: There is no result image at all.

summary: The edit was refused for lack of credits, so no image was produced and none of the must-haves were met, though the agent was honest about this.
